children: Pinterest Chief Financial Officer Julia Brau Donnelly is leaving the company for another opportunity.
The social media company appointed Vikram Naidu, currently vice president, finance and business operations, to serve as interim principal financial officer, effective when Donnelly leaves.
Pinterest said it has launched an external search process to identify a successor, and that Donnelly would stay on until Oct. 30 to support the transition.
Donnelly's exist isn't the result of any disagreement with the company or its operations, policies, or practices, it said.
